answer.summary: The API types check fails because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. The PR adds new enum values (SOURCE_CODE, CODE_REPOSITORY, CI_CD_PIPELINE, PACKAGE_REGISTRY, SOFTWARE_PACKAGE, CODE_OTHER) on the backend, but the generated types were not regenerated and committed. Regenerating the file and committing it should fix this. A re-run will fail the same way.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
